svg.title: Known limitations
svg.desc: Typing into a session in the Harness UI during a bridge run attributes that turn to the run; run ids reset when Harness restarts; prefer the background wait command over long dsh_wait calls. It also relies on Harness 0.2.1-series internal APIs.
